svg.title: The boundary of one CuliBox box
svg.desc: One CuliBox box around the project ~/work/infra. Kept outside: SSH keys, home directory, Docker socket, AWS SSO session, shell history. Inside: the agent (Claude Code today), the project folder read-write, a filtered copy of the agent config. Crossing the wall only through gates: AWS for 15 minutes, GitHub for 1 hour, static tokens for one command, and the internet through the proxy. Every grant goes to a local audit log.
svg.text: the Docker socket, root on the host
clone mode: comes home for review
